subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing pi-tui multiline keys, or should OpenClaw add a first-class configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies inline newline insertion through pi-tui, but exposing configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would create a new user-facing config or CLI surface that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings until maintainers approve the config shape.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with tests for default compatibility and alternate send/newline modes.

options.title: Treat Dependency Support As Enough
options.body: Close or narrow this issue if maintainers do not want docs/help or configurable keybinding work tracked here.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings until maintainers approve the config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current TUI editor/docs/help surface and has already reviewed the remaining product scope in the discussion.
